enshwick/mods.title: Enshwick mods
enshwick/mods.description: Mods for Enshrouded by the Enshwick team, each released on its own. They run on Enshwick, the modding framework and API for Enshrouded.

enshwick/docs.title: Enshwick docs
enshwick/docs.description: Source of enshwick.com, the site of Enshwick, the modding framework and API for Enshrouded: guides for players and server admins, docs for mod makers.

enshwick/vortex-extension.title: Enshwick Vortex extension
enshwick/vortex-extension.description: Vortex extension that installs Enshwick and Enshwick mods into the game folder. Enshwick is the modding framework and API for Enshrouded.

enshwick/.github.title: Enshwick on GitHub
enshwick/.github.description: Organization profile, community files and Renovate preset of Enshwick, the modding framework and API for Enshrouded.
